# Burning Springs: Fishing

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Dec 17, 2025
- 3 min read

Updated: Jan 6

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_95605d1894264b20a8798e788ac3fa47~mv2.jpg)

The Burning Springs update introduces 4 new fish to catch!

**IMPORTANT NOTE ABOUT SANDSTORMS**

If you are trying to catch a specific fish, such as a Local Legend or a Glowing Fish, Sandstorms are treated as Clear (No) Weather for spawn checks.

If you are completing Fish in a Sandstorm challenges, the game performs a separate condition check to confirm that either a weather station sandstorm or a natural sandstorm is active.

Burning Springs has been added to the Axolotl monthly fishing locations. Please refer to my Axolotl guide or check my social media posts for current locations.
